FINAL IVX HOLDINGS OWNERSHIP TRANSFER

Objective:
Rork is now ONLY a development assistant. IVX Holdings owns and controls production completely.

FINAL CHECKLIST

□ GitHub repository owned by IVX Holdings.
□ GitHub pushes originate only from IVX accounts.
□ Render connected directly to GitHub.
□ Supabase owned by IVX Holdings.
□ AWS owned by IVX Holdings.
□ No Rork runtime dependencies.
□ No Rork API keys.
□ No Rork webhooks.
□ No Rork Git router.
□ No Rork credential helpers.
□ No Rork URL rewrite rules.
□ No Rork background workers.
□ No Rork deployment control.
□ No Rork production secrets.
□ IVX Developer IA is the only deployment and QA system.

OWNER ACTIONS

1. Rotate AWS credentials.
2. Remove any remaining Rork GitHub OAuth application or access token.
3. Remove any remaining Rork collaborators from GitHub, Render, Supabase, and AWS.
4. Rewrite Git history if permanent removal of `.rork/history` is desired.
5. Verify a clean deployment from GitHub → Render.
6. Verify `/health` returns the current production commit.
7. Verify autonomous deployment, QA, and monitoring run under IVX infrastructure only.

FINAL SUCCESS CRITERIA

✓ GitHub controlled only by IVX.
✓ Render controlled only by IVX.
✓ Supabase controlled only by IVX.
✓ AWS controlled only by IVX.
✓ Production deploys directly from IVX GitHub.
✓ Zero Rork runtime dependencies.
✓ Zero Rork production control.
✓ IVX Developer IA manages development, QA, deployment, and monitoring.
✓ Rork is used only when the owner chooses to use it as a coding assistant.

Do not mark COMPLETE until each item has production evidence.
